title: Interpretable deep learning framework based on contrast-enhanced MRI for predicting histological grade of hepatocellular carcinoma.
summary: The MRI model predicts histological grade in hepatocellular carcinoma from patient cohorts.

organization: Department of Radiology, First Affiliated Hospital of Dalian Medical University, Dalian, China
